fields.Name: Skill Update Check
fields.Description: Re-fetches every Active skill that was imported from a URL or GitHub source (AISkill.SourceType set) and compares the content hash with AISkill.SourceContentHash. When upstream changed, the skill is set to Pending for admin review; its content is not overwritten, so nothing upstream reaches an agent's prompt unreviewed. An admin accepts the change by re-importing the skill from its source (SkillImportExportService.ImportSkillFromSource with updateSkillId), which makes it Active again, or sets it back to Active to keep the current version. No Configuration.
